name: Lifebox
whereItsAt: An Expo and React Native app. You drop in short notes, and it turns them into structured memories and events, looks for patterns, and brings back what matters in a feed called Now. It is not released, and the hardest problem, shipping a different build to each person, is still open.

lines: Studied how AI-run website testing compares with an app built for one person.
The app notices what you log on your phone and offers a matching extra in For you.
Weekly summaries of themes, never notes, are sent only if you opt in.
Design paper, draft 2: "Stable Frame, Adaptive Content".

shoots.label: A release per user
shoots.note: Open problem: an iOS build takes 30 to 60 minutes, and here every user gets their own.

shoots.label: Personal to core defaults
shoots.note: How a change made for one person graduates: Personal, then Popular, Community, Core.
